title: Propagated uncertainty and error-budget algebra
units: millimetres for geometric error; nrad only at declared transform input boundaries
accepted_inputs: DR-0010 separate tolerance channels and local uncertainty
DR-0011 semantic lineage not backend topology identity
DR-0012 regularized material and bounded deferred topology
RCS-021 bounded directional manual/freehand mill fallback
RCS-022 exact STEP profile remains interoperability_unqualified

channel_model.rule: Non-error policy/requirement channels are comparison/decision criteria and are forbidden from being numerically added as if they were solver error.

composition.transform_rule: propagate each local error through the downstream sensitivity that actually follows that stage
composition.handoff_rule: source residual + conversion residual + destination residual; never max-only replacement
composition.correlation_rule: when independence/correlation is unproven, compose conservatively
composition.rss_rule: diagnostic only; may not serve as correctness bound without explicit independence evidence
composition.cancellation_rule: only a proven shared bounded source with known coefficients may cancel
composition.unknown_rule: an unmeasured required channel remains unresolved and forces refusal rather than zero

status_contract.decisively_no_material_change: The entire physical relation interval proves clearance/no interaction, or a durable semantic replay proof establishes no additional envelope effect.
status_contract.decisively_positive_material_change: The entire physical relation/feature interval proves positive material change.
status_contract.bounded_representation_inexact: A fallback/approximate state has a demonstrated bound within its local representation budget but still requires conventional B-rep reconciliation before STEP.
status_contract.accepted_pending: The uncertainty interval overlaps a decision boundary or a positive command cannot yet be proven positive after uncertainty; signed intent remains preserved.
status_contract.error_budget_breach: A known propagated bound exceeds the requested downstream budget.
status_contract.refused_accuracy_unproven: A required bound is unknown or reconciliation is incomplete; requested accuracy cannot be demonstrated.
status_contract.export_eligible: All required channels are bounded, reconciliation is complete, and the final propagated geometric bound fits each applicable RCS-005 geometric budget.

hypotheses.statement: Conservative interval composition can carry distinct error channels end-to-end without collapsing manufacturing tolerance into numerical uncertainty.
hypotheses.falsified_by: A required representative pipeline cannot be expressed without combining requirement/policy channels as numerical error, or produces an unsound accepted export.

hypotheses.statement: Boundary decisions are safe when made only if the complete propagated physical interval lies on one side of the decision boundary.
hypotheses.falsified_by: A contact member whose interval intersects zero is classified decisively, or a strictly one-sided member remains decisive on the wrong side.

hypotheses.statement: Explicit positive-removal intent can remain pending when uncertainty exceeds feature depth without silently becoming no material change.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The 1 nm positive-removal fixture is collapsed to no-op under its 5 nm uncertainty bound.

hypotheses.statement: Naive RSS or max-only provider-handoff algebra is unsafe without evidence of independence/correlation structure.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The correlated same-sign witness is bounded by RSS and the source+conversion+destination handoff is bounded by max-only accounting.

hypotheses.statement: Error propagation is stage/order sensitive when downstream transforms have different gains.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Reordering unequal local error sources around a gain leaves the propagated bound unchanged.

hypotheses.statement: STEP/export eligibility can fail closed by comparing the final propagated bound with RCS-005 budgets while refusing unknown channels.
hypotheses.falsified_by: An over-budget or unbounded reconciliation case is marked export eligible.

rcs005_mapping.prototype_scope: This executable v1 model closes the linear/spatial geometric bound path used for dimension/surface eligibility. Volume/angular budgets remain separate declared RCS-005 acceptance channels and may not be inferred from a linear bound without a geometry-specific sensitivity proof.
rcs005_mapping.fail_closed_rule: Every required geometric channel must be bounded and reconciled. The final propagated spatial bound must be <= each applicable requested dimension/surface budget; unresolved required channels or incomplete reconciliation refuse export.

provenance_rule: Durable traces retain programme journal/revision/body/semantic identifiers only. Provider-private topology handles/process identity are rejected from durable context.
out_of_scope: statistical calibration claiming independent errors without evidence
